method_inheritance: Every stage inherits the exact QE version, PBE functional, Cu/Na UPF hashes, cutoffs, smearing, slab dimensions, vacuum, k mesh, and electrostatic convention from PASS handoffs.

stage_3_clean_relaxation.symmetry: paired layers constrained to move symmetrically about the slab center

stage_4_na_pseudopotential.archive: same pinned SSSP v2 PBE-efficiency archive used for Cu
stage_4_na_pseudopotential.selection: unique UPF whose parsed element attribute is Na; ambiguity gives HOLD
stage_4_na_pseudopotential.mixed_cutoffs: componentwise maximum of independently registered Cu and Na recommendations

stage_5_adsorption_screening.coverage_model: one Na adatom in a 4x4 primitive Cu(001) surface supercell, approximately 0.0625 ML
stage_5_adsorption_screening.electrostatics: single-sided adsorption with the same explicitly registered slab correction for every site, or symmetric two-sided adsorption if selected before launch
stage_5_adsorption_screening.relaxation: Na and registered upper Cu layers relaxed; lower/central constraint inherited from clean slab
stage_5_adsorption_screening.site_pass_rule: all starts converge; endpoint identities and energy ordering are reported without discarding site collapse

checks: endpoints related by a primitive surface translation

stage_7_path_convergence.initial_path: hollow-to-hollow translation through the intervening bridge region
stage_7_path_convergence.pass_rule: smallest image count whose forward barrier differs by <= 0.005 eV from every larger registered image count and whose endpoints do not drift

pass_checks: endpoint energies reproduce verified endpoints within 0.001 eV
all image coordinates and outputs hashed

stage_9_saddle_verification.method: finite-displacement curvature along the converged reaction coordinate plus downhill connectivity checks
requirements: negative curvature along the path direction
positive restoring behavior for sampled transverse displacements
downhill relaxation reaches the two registered endpoint basins

stage_10_barrier_coordinate.primary: electronic forward and reverse barriers from verified endpoints and saddle
stage_10_barrier_coordinate.separation_rule: electronic, zero-point, thermal, friction, and experimental quantities remain separate fields
stage_10_barrier_coordinate.null_rule: friction, linewidth, or damping fields remain null unless independently computed or publicly reported for the same state point

stage_11_atlas_admission.rule: computed and experimental values occupy distinct columns and are never blended into one coordinate

stage_12_integration.rule: integration may proceed with explicit HOLD fields, but no HOLD may be described as closed
